shots.full: A photorealistic medium close-up film still in the same bare brick back room as the reference image, at night. Camera just below his eye line, 85mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field. Mr Red fills the right half of the frame from the chest up, seated at the table, face turned three-quarters toward someone just off the left edge, mouth closed in a satisfied smile, holding a short glass of whisky still at chest height as if about to toast. The near left third of the frame is the soft, dark, out-of-focus shoulder and silver hair of the man he is talking to. A warm amber bare bulb above and in front of him, to the right, lights his face and mouth; the green glow of a fire-exit sign rims the far side of his head. At the bottom edge, blurred, the corner of a crumpled newspaper with a plain blank red band. Kodak Vision3 500T, unretouched, visible pores, fine grain. 16:9. Thanks.
